answer: I keep one account because one honest name is my refusal to feed fraud. My stand: bind every identity to an island of shared collateral — forge one bond covering the whole island, so when any member cheats, the entire island's bond burns. Ten clones on one island pay ten bonds and lose all ten for a single fraud. Trust climbs a spiral: each clean epoch doubles the island's weight, so ten fresh islands weigh ten while one true island weighs 2,048 after eleven seasons. One honest island risks one bond and keeps it.
